mapper.sql: m.id AS id, m.workspace_id AS workspaceId, m.uploader_id AS uploaderId, m.title AS title, m.original_filename AS originalFilename, m.source_key AS sourceKey, m.source_size AS sourceSize, m.source_hash AS sourceHash, m.status AS status, m.version AS version, m.duration_ms AS durationMs, m.width AS width, m.height AS height, m.output_key AS outputKey, m.poster_key AS posterKey, m.deleted_at AS deletedAt, m.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media (id, workspace_id, uploader_id, title, original_filename, source_key, source_size, source_hash, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{m.id}, #{m.workspaceId}, #{m.uploaderId}, #{m.title}, #{m.originalFilename}, #{m.sourceKey}, #{m.sourceSize}, #{m.sourceHash}, #{m.status}, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media m WHERE m.id = #{mediaId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM media m WHERE m.id = #{mediaId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM media m WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media m WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE media SET title = #{title}, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{mediaId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE media SET deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{mediaId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media m WHERE m.id = #{mediaId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media WHERE source_key = #{storageKey} OR output_key = #{storageKey} OR poster_key = #{storageKey}
SELECT FROM media m WHERE m.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND m.deleted_at < DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{lookbackSeconds} SECOND) LIMIT #{limit}
